content:
Is a personal loan the right way to pay off your credit cards?

If you carry balances on three or four cards, a single fixed-payment loan can simplify things. ClearPath Personal Loans range from $2,000 to $50,000 with APRs of 8.99% to 35.99%, depending on your credit profile. Checking your rate takes a soft pull, so there is no impact to your credit score.

Before you apply, compare the loan's APR against the average rate on your cards, and read the fee schedule: origination fees of 0% to 8% may apply.

Ready to see your rate? Check your rate with ClearPath: https://clearpath.example/apply?partner=loanlens&subid=post-118

Terms apply.
